ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:6 ratio of high-intensity white/grey pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Concentrated high-intensity white mottling at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered white speckling along the trailing margins; central and lower regions consist of a contiguous low-intensity black field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations; left lobe trailing edge features a significant, large-scale semi-circular concave indentation located approximately mid-way between the notch and the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curvature along the trailing boundary of both lobes extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular high-contrast white marks localized at the left lobe tip and along the peripheral margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned vertical and diagonal linear white disruptions visible on the dark pigmented surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, deep semi-circular notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe lobe indicating prior physical trauma.
